description: You have multiple student loans and received refinancing offers. Read loan details from /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/loan_info.txt. Create a comprehensive comparison spreadsheet saved as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/refi_comparison.xlsx with three sheets: (1) 'Current Loans Analysis' - list all 6 loans with data and SUM formulas for totals, (2) 'Refinancing Offers' - list 3 offers with formulas calculating total cost over loan life, (3) 'Decision Matrix' - compare all options with savings calculations.
